C0820.title: Verizon DBIR 2023 Highlights Expanding ATO Attack Surface
C0820.summary: The 2023 Verizon Data Breach Investigations Report reveals that account takeover (ATO) attacks are no longer confined to financial institutions; any organization with a customer login interface can be targeted.
